Anna — appreciate the quick follow-up and the list. Short answers below so your billing team can bundle things cleanly.

Required tax evidence for EU vendors (minimum set)
- VAT registration certificate (clear scan, include VAT ID) — required
- Certificate of tax residency or local tax office letter (if available) — preferred for OSS cases
- Company registration extract (showing legal entity and address) — required for entity validation
- Proof of registered bank account (bank letter or a voided cheque / bank statement showing company name and IBAN) — required for payment setup

Invoice formatting & PO mapping
- PO number format: RW-###### (six digits). Please include the PO on line 1 of the invoice and in the invoice metadata field.
- We require gross and net VAT lines separated; indicate VAT rate applied and VAT amount per line item.
- For reverse-charge shipments (cross-border services), include wording: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient per Article XYZ" and clearly state the supplier VAT ID.

Attachments and technical items
- Please attach the VAT cert and bank proof here. We will upload these to our supplier portal and create a procurement record.
- I am attaching our PO invoice specification (Redwood_PO_Template_Invoice-Spec.xlsx) — follow that layout to avoid manual rematching.

Next steps / timeline
1) You send VAT cert + bank proof (you mentioned you'll attach).
2) We validate documents (1–2 business days).
3) Redwood issues a first PO (test invoice recommended).
4) If test invoice matches, we set you to "active" for recurring POs.

Cc'ing Laura (AP lead) and Kim (procurement ops) to pick up validation and follow-up if we need additional evidence.

If you have any country-specific quirks (e.g., special reference numbers in Poland), flag them and we'll include those fields in the vendor record.

Best,

Hi Anna — thanks for the attachments, they look complete at first pass. A few operational notes and confirmations: 

1) Payment terms: Redwood standard for new suppliers is NET 30. We can discuss NET 45 as an exception with Finance, but please provision invoices with NET 30 for the PO lifecycle.

2) VAT treatment: for freight and logistics where the supplier is in the EU and the service recipient is Redwood (entity: Redwood Inference EU SARL, FR VAT ID FR987654321), we will generally apply reverse charge where the service is cross-border. We do not require local VAT registration unless (a) you have a local establishment in a country where Redwood has a taxable presence, or (b) local law requires supplier registration to issue invoices. If you anticipate local registrations, flag the country and we can coordinate.

3) Invoice matching: please include the PO number RW-000124 on invoices. Use the attached spec (Olga sent) for line items. If your ERP can't insert the PO automatically, include the PO manually on line 1 and in the invoice XML metadata.

4) Test invoice: once you receive PO RW-000124, please send a single test invoice (small amount) so our AP can validate auto-matching and VAT lines. After successful match, we'll mark you as active.

5) Attachments: we'll store the VAT cert and bank proof in the vendor record. No further docs required unless tax residency proves ambiguous.

Action items:
- Aquila: send test invoice against RW-000124 within 3 business days of receiving the PO.
- Redwood (Laura): confirm account setup and send PO to vendor once validation completes (target: today EOD).

Thanks — welcome aboard.

Best regards,
